ghostracer_set_start.title: Ghost Racer: Set / restart lap start
ghostracer_set_start.desc: Place the start/finish gate at the current position and start a lap (free roam)
ghostracer_set_start.onDown: if extensions and extensions.ghostlapping and extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeySetStartLine then extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeySetStartLine() end

ghostracer_toggle_auto_lap.title: Ghost Racer: Toggle auto lap
ghostracer_toggle_auto_lap.desc: Arm or disarm free-roam automatic lap recording at the current start
ghostracer_toggle_auto_lap.onDown: if extensions and extensions.ghostlapping and extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeyToggleAutoLap then extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeyToggleAutoLap() end

ghostracer_clear_start.title: Ghost Racer: Clear lap start
ghostracer_clear_start.desc: Deactivate the current start's live functions (its Ghost library is kept)
ghostracer_clear_start.onDown: if extensions and extensions.ghostlapping and extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeyClearStartLine then extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeyClearStartLine() end

ghostracer_set_finish.title: Ghost Racer: Set finish gate (point-to-point)
ghostracer_set_finish.desc: Place a finish gate at the current position, making the start a point-to-point run
ghostracer_set_finish.onDown: if extensions and extensions.ghostlapping and extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeySetFinishLine then extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeySetFinishLine() end

ghostracer_clear_finish.title: Ghost Racer: Clear finish gate
ghostracer_clear_finish.desc: Remove the finish gate, returning the start to a circuit lap
ghostracer_clear_finish.onDown: if extensions and extensions.ghostlapping and extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeyClearFinishLine then extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeyClearFinishLine() end

ghostracer_new_variant.title: Ghost Racer: New track variant
ghostracer_new_variant.desc: Add another track (separate ghost library) at the current start position
ghostracer_new_variant.onDown: if extensions and extensions.ghostlapping and extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeyCreateStartVariant then extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeyCreateStartVariant() end

ghostracer_toggle_ui_mini.title: Ghost Racer: Toggle app mini / full size
ghostracer_toggle_ui_mini.desc: Toggle the Ghost Racer app between its full panel and the compact mini badge
ghostracer_toggle_ui_mini.onDown: if extensions and extensions.ghostlapping and extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeyToggleMinimize then extensions.ghostlapping.hotkeyToggleMinimize() end
